name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 19 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.01 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
